title: [lazy-file, file-storage]: LazyFile not extending File leaves other packages and examples broken.
author: Apsysikal
body_preview: In version `5.0.0` LazyFile stopped extending `File` and `Blob`. The reasons, although not applicable to me, seem like a great thing.  This change leads to other packages like `file-storage` broken. For example `file-storage` says it returns an instance of `File` which it actually doesn't: it returns an instance of LazyFile.
